concept.title: Migration Prerequisites
concept.shortdesc: Before submitting a document to the metR DOCX to DITA converter, verify the following prerequisites

conbody.p: Before submitting a document to the metR DOCX to DITA converter, verify the following prerequisites are met:

ul.li: The file is saved in .docx format. Legacy .doc files must be converted to .docx before submission.
All content that must appear in DITA uses approved Word styles: Title, Heading 1–N, Normal or Body Text, List Bullet, List Number, and table styles.
Images are set to In Line with Text wrap mode.
Lists are created using Word's built-in list buttons, not manually typed bullets or numbers.

conbody.note: If your document uses custom styles not listed in this guide, contact the Metapercept DITA architecture or consulting team. The converter configuration can be customized to support custom style mappings.
